Team / Sarah & Ben —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. We want to lock the executive briefing (EB) and the mutual action plan (MAP) so we can close within your Q2 target. Two asks in this thread:

1) Exec sponsor mapping — can we confirm Novus executive sponsors and map them to Redwood execs who will attend? My proposed mapping (initial draft attached):
   - Novus: Jennifer Malone (COO) -> Redwood: Vivek Kulkarni (Head of Worldwide Sales)
   - Novus: Elaine Rodriguez (CISO) -> Redwood: Ethan Park (Security Lead)

2) EB scheduling — we propose two slots next week (all times PT):
   - Option A: Tue Mar 10, 10:30–11:15am PT
   - Option B: Wed Mar 11, 2:00–2:45pm PT

Please confirm preferred slot and any additional attendee from Novus (legal/procurement). I attached a draft MAP (Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short EB agenda.

Sidenote: Jonas — can you own the EB deck and run the 20-minute product + ROI section? Rachel, can you own the procurement checklist and attach the contract timeline? Priyom, can you prepare the quantization/cost model slide?

Thanks — aiming to get this on calendars and the MAP signed before end of Q2.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Marissa — thanks, this is helpful.

Quick answers from Novus:
- We confirm Jennifer Malone (COO) as primary executive sponsor; Elaine (CISO) should be on the EB for security posture questions.
- Procurement will want to join for the final 15 minutes: Tom Gray (t.gray@novushealth.com). Legal will be looped if there are anything substantive in the SOW.

For timing we prefer Option B (Wed Mar 11, 2:00–2:45pm PT). Can you lock that? Also please include a brief slide for implementation milestones (30/60/90) and a short summary of support model/SLA.

One more ask: can you tag the MAP with decision owners and a timeline row for procurement? Procurement is on a tight window for our year-end.

Best,
